feedback: The original task's 'cheap probe' hint — 'remove only ring-ring/50, re-run, then only dark:bg-input/30' — would not have isolated the trigger because both are opacity shorthands; the decisive probe was removing only `ring-2` (a ring WIDTH utility with no opacity), so future probes should bisect by utility family (ring-* vs border-* vs bg-*) rather than by opacity.

The task framed the trigger as 'opacity-shorthand classes', which biased the diagnosis away from `ring-2`; when a css-interop render-time race is suspected, target the utility family on the conditional className, not opacity.
